text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - elevated queue tail and 502/504 spike in ap-southeast-1 hosted pool
- symptom: queue_wait_p95 ~ 15s, runtime.request_5xx_rate ~ 6% for model:redwood-7b-v2
- affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embed (heavy batch)
- alert link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/99901

Nisha R: I'm oncall. Paging Tom and Victor. Starting triage — looks like long-batch jobs + streaming churn.

Tom K: on it. Quick question - is this noisy from a few orgs or broad?

infra-bot: top orgs by queued tokens: gamma-labs (35%), small-plg-batchers (27%), media-synth (15%). Several workers reported high RSS and restart loops in old-quant nodes.

Victor L: probable contributors: streaming backpressure + KV cache growth for long lived sessions. Immediate mitigation checklist: 1) reduce max_in_flight per-worker 2) shorten queue_ttl/fail-fast 3) enable priority shedding for low-tier requests 4) apply per-org inflight caps for top offenders 5) consider temporarily disabling chunked streaming for generation routes.

Nisha R: executing conservative changes now: max_in_flight 14->5, queue_ttl 40s->8s, enable shedding_policy=priority-tier. Also apply a soft rate limit on embed batch size for hosted tier.

Nisha R: command:
```
redwoodctl runtime update --region ap-southeast-1 --pool hosted-gen-ap --set max_in_flight=5 --set queue_ttl=8s --set shedding_policy=priority-tier --note "oncall mitigation 2159876543"
```

DeployBot: runtime-update job started: ru-job-2159876543-01. Rolling to 30% of hosted-gen-ap workers.

Tom K: also reduce upstream request timeout to 25s so requests don't hold KV/caches for too long.

Nisha R: applying route timeout change and a temporary batch-size cap for embeddings:
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --timeout 25s --region ap-southeast-1
redwoodctl route update /v1/embed --set max_batch_size=64 --region ap-southeast-1 --note "mitigation"
```

DeployBot: route-update jobs accepted (ru-route-2159876543-02, ru-route-2159876543-03). Changes effective for new sessions.

ops-bot: telemetry after partial rollout (~90s): queue_p95 14.8s -> 6.2s, 5xx rate 6.1% -> 2.8%. Some legacy quant workers still show OOMs.

Victor L: good improvement. I'll identify top offending orgs and apply per-org caps + token windows to contain blast radius. Gamma-labs looks eligible for a short cap.

Nisha R: go ahead with per-org caps. Also thinking to enable KV early-eviction for sessions > 3k tokens behind a feature flag.

Victor L: running per-org commands:
```
redwood-admin org update --org gamma-labs --set max_inflight=6 --set token_budget=50000 --expires-in 2h --reason "emergency mitigation 2159876543"
redwood-admin org update --org media-synth --set max_inflight=4 --set token_budget=30000 --expires-in 1h --reason "emergency mitigation"
```

infra-bot: org cap jobs queued: orgcap-2159876543-04, orgcap-2159876543-05.

CSM-bot: top impacted customers notified for outreach: gamma-labs, media-synth. Suggested message queued to CSMs.

Tom K: also flip feature flag for KV early-eviction (staged) and reduce streaming chunk-size to reduce CPU churn. 10% rollout first.

Nisha R: staging feature flag:
```
redwoodctl feature-flag set kv_early_eviction=true --filter "model:long-seq" --region ap-southeast-1 --rollout 10% --note "mitigation"
redwoodctl runtime update --region ap-southeast-1 --pool hosted-gen-ap --set stream_chunk_size=256 --rollout 10% --note "streaming throttle"
```

DeployBot: feature flag and runtime changes queued: ff-2159876543-06, ru-job-2159876543-07.

infra-bot: metrics after 6m: queue_p95 6.2s -> 3.1s, 5xx 2.8% -> 1.3%, inflight_rate down to 60%. Early eviction flag showing reduced RSS in canary workers.

Nisha R: good. Support/CSM outreach draft:
"We observed higher latency and intermittent 5xx for long/persistent generation sessions in ap-southeast-1. We've applied mitigations (reduced worker concurrency, per-org caps, queue TTL reduction, and temporary batch limits). We're monitoring and will update within 60 minutes. If you need immediate assistance we can offer temporary quota routing to dedicated nodes."

Victor L: recommend giving gamma-labs a short quota bump and route them to standby dedicated if they accept. I'll coordinate with sales/CS.

Nisha R: granting provisional 1-hour quota bump and routing preference:
```
redwood-admin quota adjust --org gamma-labs --incr tokens_per_minute=40000 --expires-in 1h --reason "incident mitigation 2159876543"
redwoodctl routing promote --org gamma-labs --target dedicated-ap-sg --reason "spillover mitigation"
```

DeployBot: quota job q-2159876543-08 applied. Routing promotion queued.

Tom K: observed a couple of 502s with stack trace showing runtime queue timeout -> propagate to postmortem: why wasn't fail-fast earlier? Consider adding pre-queue admission control for very large token requests.

Nisha R: noted for postmortem. For now we'll keep shedding_policy and per-org caps on. Plan to gradually increase max_in_flight only if metrics remain stable for 20m. I'll monitor for 30m and then hand off to Victor for longer watch and postmortem write-up.

Victor L: taking handoff at +30m. Immediate tasks: collect heap dumps from legacy quant nodes, verify rollback plan for stream_chunk changes, and draft postmortem action items (adaptive concurrency, pre-queue admission, fail-fast enforcement).

infra-bot: captured job ids: ru-job-2159876543-01, ru-route-2159876543-02, ru-route-2159876543-03, orgcap-2159876543-04, orgcap-2159876543-05, ff-2159876543-06, ru-job-2159876543-07, q-2159876543-08. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2159876543 (severity S2).

Nisha R: status @ +25m: p95 queue 3.0s, 5xx 1.1%. Leaving mitigations in place. Handing to Victor at +30m for further watch. Will remain on slack for escalation. :white_check_mark:
